channel.title: GNUS digest
channel.description: Daily digest of the GeniusVentures GitHub activity, written from public commit messages.

item.title: GNUS digest — Sunday 22 November
item.description: The wallet application received fixes to its startup messages and name‑change behavior, plus a configuration tweak. The blockchain network component was repaired to clean up records, adjust funding handling, and added test work. Repositories: GeniusWallet, SuperGenius, rlp_enodes.

item.title: GNUS digest — Saturday 21 November
item.description: New recovery and verification features were added to the blockchain system, along with fixes and extensive testing. The network layer received upgrades, documentation updates, and further testing. Repositories: SuperGenius, GeniusNetwork, rlp_enodes.

item.title: GNUS digest — Friday 20 November
item.description: Research‑related fixes and testing were applied to the network component, and downgrade handling was added to the blockchain system with accompanying tests and documentation. Small improvements were also made to developer tools. Repositories: GeniusNetwork, SuperGenius, openapi-client-scaffold, openapi-cpp-scaffolding, GeniusCognitiveSystem, GeniusSDK.

item.title: GNUS digest — Thursday 19 November
item.description: A new research phase and several fixes were introduced to the network, along with upgrades and testing of verification items. The blockchain component added a probe for growth tracking and related tests, and documentation was clarified. Repositories: GeniusNetwork, SuperGenius, gitbook, documentation, openapi-cpp-scaffolding, openapi-client-scaffold.

item.title: GNUS digest — Wednesday 18 November
item.description: Plan revisions and testing were performed for the network, and documentation was updated. Developer tools received pagination improvements and related tests. The blockchain system added an evidence matrix and related testing. Repositories: GeniusNetwork, openapi-cpp-scaffolding, SuperGenius.

item.title: GNUS digest — Tuesday 17 November
item.description: Documentation for a new phase plan was added to the network. The blockchain component introduced durability checks and testing. Developer tools added new overrides and tests, and a build template was updated to handle missing directories. Repositories: GeniusNetwork, SuperGenius, openapi-cpp-scaffolding, cmaketemplate.
